name: croquis
description: Constrained 2D sketches and schematics: SolidWorks-style relations and dimensions, a solver that checks the sketch is fully defined, and SVG / PDF / TikZ export. Web app plus a zero-dependency CLI and library for scripts and AI agents.
author: Stépane Binon (https://www.linkedin.com/in/stepane-binon/)

scripts.example: node croquis.mjs example | node croquis.mjs build - --svg example.svg --require-full
